units.source_text: 此时阿光像一个被人欺负的孩子，欺负她的人倒不是阿留。

en.t: At that moment, A Guang was like a child who had been bullied, though the one who had bullied her was not A Liu.

units.source_text: 尽管这孩子得到母亲的保护，把欺负她的人赶走，并安慰了她，

en.t: Although this child had been protected by her mother, who drove away the person bullying her and comforted her,

units.source_text: 可回想起来，被人欺负的根源在于自己淘气，

en.t: when she thought back on it, the root of being bullied lay in her own naughtiness,

units.source_text: 就对自己发誓：“以后老实点吧。”

en.t: so she made a vow to herself: From now on, I will behave better.

units.source_text: 她这颗童稚般纯洁的心在起伏翻腾。

en.t: Her innocent, childlike heart was surging and tossing within her.

units.source_text: 不知怎的，竟羞愧得无地自容，

en.t: Somehow, she became so ashamed that she felt she had nowhere to hide,

units.source_text: 连那弯曲的膝盖也伸展不直了。

en.t: and even her bent knees could no longer straighten out.

units.source_text: 阿光如同世间的寻常女人一样，在无鞍的马背上正襟危坐。

en.t: Like any ordinary woman in the world, A Guang sat upright and proper on the bare back of the horse.
